summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting in the repository, without committing and without running tests, mypy, or Black. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in the ControlCode union; rich/control.py adds the format entry producing "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and the Control.title classmethod; rich/console.py adds set_window_title beside show_cursor (buffers the title control when is_terminal, returns True/False); rich/_windows_renderer.py adds a SET_WINDOW_TITLE branch calling term.set_title; CHANGELOG.md gets one Unreleased Added bullet linking #2200. Tests added in tests/test_console.py (skipped on win32), tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows-only). Not verified by execution.
